thinking: The user wants a website for "可衣" (Kewai?), a women's clothing online shop in Shanghai, targeting women 20-40, for daily and office wear. Needs pages: homepage, product list page (with items, size, price), product detail page, cart page. They want it as a deployable static site. Must not mention AI or anything. Must have CSS and JS in files. Use relative links. No external resources. No target="_blank". Provide at least 3 pages: index.html, product-list.html, product-detail.html, cart.html. They mention "至少另外两个页面" so we need at least 3 pages total (index + 2). We provide 4 pages. All links relative. Use relative navigation. Use Chinese. Provide content realistic. Provide sample products. We'll need CSS for layout, maybe simple grid. Provide minimal JS for cart management (but no real backend, so cart stored in localStorage or session). The cart page can display items added via localStorage. Provide "Add to cart" button. The product list page shows items with link to product detail pages. Use relative link names like product1.html etc. We must include CSS and JavaScript in the same files. Probably embed
